Here's where it stands today, same order.

The NerdQX you kept was delivered August 13. The O. Bundle is in the US shipment that's already booked with the carrier, and that shipment covers orders up to Shop····, so yours is in it. The arrival date is being re-confirmed, so I won't repeat mid October as if it were firm. You can follow that shipment at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The duplicate NerdQX line is still with the team to take off and settle.
What’s the warranty on the nerdQx?
Handed to the team · warranty length not something I can quote

I'm not going to quote you a length on that one. The published terms are being reconciled right now, and your unit's covered either way, so I'd rather give you the exact wording than a number I'd have to walk back. The team has it and one of them will jump in here with it, or it comes to your email if you step away.

One thing I can say plainly: a unit that's been overclocked or modified isn't covered. Worth knowing before the bundle arrives.
Let’s try a different way. The web site says contact the manufacturer within one year. How do I do that?

You don't. Come to us, not the manufacturer. We handle it through our RMA, and that's the only intake: fill this in and you get a return label. https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse.

Is the NerdQX actually playing up, or are you just mapping out the cover before you overclock it?

It’s been running 24/7 with a monthly average hash rate of about 7Th/s since I received it. Today it popped its 15A fuse. The power supply under no load puts out 12.4 volts dc. Putting in a spare 15A fuse popped immediately.

A fuse that pops instantly on a fresh one is a dead short pulling current the moment it's powered, and your PSU reading 12.4V off load points downstream, at the miner, not the supply. Don't fit another fuse.

Start the RMA, same form as above, and note the blown fuse and the 12.4V reading.

I've put this to JD, who handles the hardware. Fastest is Discord right now, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate. Otherwise his reply comes here or by email.
